title: Drums and playing with Erskine Tate at the Vendome
summary: Asked about his first instrument and band, Bertrand says drums and names Erskine Tate's band at the Vendome as the best he played in for years.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: I was going to ask, when you started on the drums, is that your first instrument or? Mm-hmm. On the drums? Mm-hmm. Yeah. And what was the first band you played with? So many bands. I guess so many.
The best band I've played was Erskine Tate.
Is that at the Van Dome?
I played with Ty, that's the Van Dome for years. We had the best band anybody at all.
